extracted.intended_audience: readers interested in advertising, brand marketing professionals, and general Ad Age audience
extracted.subtask_description: A short news report about an advertising campaign that provoked public discomfort and prompted a corporate apology; summarizes the incident and public reaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid disturbing imagery in ads
rubrics_metrics.description: Many viewers were disturbed by the ad’s imagery of a crusher flattening creative objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied standard: creative work should avoid visuals likely to upset or alienate viewers; test imagery for potential negative reactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prompt acknowledgement and apology when an ad misfires
rubrics_metrics.description: Apple apologizes for iPad Pro ad that ‘missed the mark’.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied guidance: brands should acknowledge mistakes and apologize publicly when campaigns offend or generate significant negative reaction to limit reputational damage.
